verdict.stance: Overweight / USD-Tariff PSA-Operated Turkish Gateway Port (BB- Pos / B)
verdict.summary: Operated by PSA International (51%) and Akfen (49%), Mersin Port collects unregulated USD-denominated tariffs supporting 60-70% EBITDA margins. Fitch maintains BB- Positive on the $600m 8.25% Nov-28 notes (XS2696793012), contrasting favorably with LimakPort's volume struggles.

positives: Unregulated hard-currency USD tariffs insulating against TRY inflation/FX.
60-70% EBITDA margins and PSA International operational backing.
negatives: Concession expiry risk (2043) and Eastern Med / Red Sea shipping volatility.
Eventual dividend upstreaming pressure to Akfen/PSA sponsors.

background.business_overview: Turkey's largest multipurpose gateway container port on the Mediterranean.
background.asset_perimeter: 36-year Port of Mersin concession (to 2043) + East Med Hub 2 expansion.
